title: Vault chaos engineering
summary: Four chaos experiments on a three-node Vault cluster with integrated storage, run with Gremlin under load from the Vault benchmark tool: losing the leader (a standby takes over with little effect), losing quorum (reads and writes stop until you follow the recovery runbook), added latency and memory pressure. A concrete worked example of hypothesis, steady-state metrics and abort conditions; written by HashiCorp with help from Gremlin, so the fixes it suggests lean on Vault Enterprise features such as performance standbys and DR clusters.
